source.chart_pane_note: measured from the clean capture of the same 1500 x 800 pt window at a 1920 px client width: the day tier drew 87 px per 12-hour column and the chart pane spanned 1020 px. The pane width is not a COM property; the oracle records only the command windows.
source.fit_rule: Project draws the fitted span across 85 % of the chart pane (15 % margin, centred) and floors the window's start to its bottom-tier column start. That tier is finer than a day on these windows, so several carry sub-day margins (the base Selected window starts at 06:00) that the port's day tier cannot express; the comparison therefore checks the 85 % ideal and containment, not an equal window length.
source.selection_note: Selected Tasks is the first zoom command in each session, with one row selected: Application.SelectRow(2), after which ActiveSelection reports task ID 3 on both fixtures. Project 2021 raises a COM exception (E_FAIL) when ZoomSelectedTasks runs after another zoom command, and on synthetic-base it also raises for the two-row selection; a single row is the only reproducible shape. On both fixtures task 3 is shorter than the project (1.958 vs 4.958 days; 3.375 vs 7.375), so Selected Tasks cannot be confused with Entire Project. Two fresh sessions per fixture produced identical windows.
source.dialog_source: build/w31/zoom_dialog_facts.py through the local UI Automation driver (build/w31/uia_drive.ps1), one sequential session on synthetic-base.mpp, output build/w31/zoom-dialog-facts.json. The presets were applied in the order listed; the 3-month step's origin moved one day because the 1-month step had already re-anchored the view, so only the window lengths are used. The custom 42-day control did not apply in that run (the window equalled 3 months), so no custom measurement is recorded.
